newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-IDEXX cut to attractive.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-IDEXX cut to attractive.

text.p: Vector Securities International Inc said Friday it had cut its rating on IDEXX Laboratories Inc to attractive from buy after the company warned it would report an operating loss for the second quarter.
-- said has a $15 price target on IDEXX.
-- said would recommend purchase should the stock fall below $10 a share.
-- On Thursday IDEXX said it expected to report a second quarter operating loss due to lower-than-expected sales, increased investment spending and higher inventories.
-- Vector said it cut its revenue estimate for the company's Professional Office Division to $191 million from $208 million for 1997 and to $209 million from $242 million for 1998.
-- also cut its overall earnings estimate to $0.15 a share from $0.39 for 1997, and to $0.55 from $0.75 for 1998.
-- said that on a positive note, IDEXX announced plans for a mail-order pharmacy to supply veterinarians with human drugs authorized for off-label use in animals.
-- "Although we have conservatively not included revenues from this program into our model, we believe the potential is there for a healthy revenue stream," Vector said in a report.
